self.db
.lock()
.unwrap()
.query_row(
"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operators WHERE name=?1 OR key_id=?2",
params![name, key_id],
|r| r.get::<_, i64>(0),
)
.map(|n| n > 0)
.map_err(sql)
}
